name: Cheesy Spinach & Rice Stuffed Portobello Mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Once liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry mushrooms; remove stems and carefully scrape out gills, making sure not to damage the rim of the mushrooms. Divide between two baking sheets and rub with oil; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 caps portobello mushrooms
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add garlic to the pot and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Wash and dry the spinach. (Skip if it came pre-washed.) Add to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add Parmesan, yogurt, salt, and pepper to the pot and stir to combine; remove from the heat. When the rice is done, add to the pot and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups plain Greek yogurt
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Fill mushroom caps with equal portions of the rice mixture. Place in the oven and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove baking sheets from oven and top mushrooms with mozzarella. Bake for another 5-7 minutes, until cheese is golden and melted.
To serve, divide mushrooms between plates. Enjoy!
